components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The rare accent-filled action — approve, save, send.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-contrast); border: none; border-radius: 7px; padding: 4px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default button of the app — quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); border: none; border-radius: 5px; padding: 2px 7px; font: inherit; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A board card: 3px lane-accent top bar, dense two-line body.
components.html: r52wuFix drag jerk in lane
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: var(--bg-hover); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-top: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; cursor: grab; } .ds-card-id { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); } .ds-card-title { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill chip for tags, counts, WIP warnings.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: var(--bg-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.04)); color: var(--text-muted); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field — mono variant for ids/paths.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Centered overlay panel — card editor, confirmations.

components.css: .ds-modal { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); max-width: 400px; } .ds-modal-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-modal-body { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Mono block with header strip — scrolls, never wraps.
components.css: .ds-code { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg); } .ds-code-head { padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--bg-panel); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-code-body { margin: 0; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text); overflow-x: auto; }

narrative.overview:
A board is an operations room, not a landing page. Everything is flat, bordered, and quiet: neutral gray surfaces stack by tone, hairline borders do the separating, and exactly one soft blue accent is allowed to speak. Density is a feature — a kanban card carries an id, a title, chips, and a lane color in two lines of 12px text, and the board still breathes. The work is the color; the interface is the wall it hangs on.

The mono voice carries all metadata. Card ids, paths, lane names, counts, timestamps, and version chips are 11px JetBrains Mono in muted grays — the terminal cadence of the pi agent the board serves. Body and titles are the native system stack, never decorative.

Light theme is the same system on white: the gray ladder flips direction, the accent deepens for contrast on white, and nothing else changes. Themes swap token values only; no component ever hardcodes a theme.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, 1px borders, tonal layering — shadows only for floating layers (modals, drawers, popovers)
One accent (soft slate blue) at ≤10% of any screen; eight muted lane hues are the only other colors
Mono 11px for all meta; system sans for body and titles
Tight radii: 8px panels, 7px controls, 5px small bits
Scrollbars invisible until their container scrolls

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on ≤10% of any screen. If everything is accented, nothing is.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px border or a tone step, never a shadow at rest and never a second border color.

rules.name: The Fixed Palette Rule
rules.body: No new hues. UI color = grays + accent; lanes = the eight lane hues; status = error/warn. Anything else is a bug in the design, not a feature.

rules.name: The Mono-Meta Rule
rules.body: If a string would be typed into a terminal (id, path, sha, command, count), it renders in mono at meta size. If a human wrote it as prose, it's sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. A shadow means "I float above the board" — popover, drawer, modal — and nothing else.

dos: Do use color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) N%, transparent) for translucent borders — one border token, infinite alphas.
Do give every interactive element a :focus-visible style (2px accent, 2px offset) — the board is keyboard-driven as much as mouse-driven.
Do render ids, paths, counts, and commands in mono meta text.
Do stack toggle states with multiple cues (filled icon + tinted pill + accent), never hue alone.
Do keep touch targets ≥44px under 640px and on coarse pointers.
Do check the z-ladder before adding any fixed/overlay element (40 / 45 / 55), and hide chrome above 40 when a modal opens.
donts: Don't add a new hue, gradient, or font — grays + accent + lane eight + error/warn is the whole palette; system stacks are the whole type system.
Don't shadow anything at rest, or use borders on floating layers without their popover shadow.
Don't wrap code blocks; they scroll.
Don't use emoji or icon fonts in the UI; Lucide SVGs for buttons, text glyphs for chips and CLI-rendered states.
Don't let an accent fill exceed ~10% of a screen — primary buttons stay small and rare.
Don't invent per-component colors that bypass the token vars; theme switching (dark ↔ light) must stay a pure token swap.
